high_level_description: A professional game art blueprint sheet of a sleek futuristic sports car designed for a racing video game, presented as a clean multi-view modeling reference with one polished hero render and several orthographic views.

style_description.aesthetics: clean technical game art presentation, high-end vehicle design, professional concept sheet, precise and readable layout
style_description.lighting: neutral studio lighting for the perspective render, flat even lighting for orthographic views, crisp visibility and minimal shadows
style_description.art_style: AAA vehicle concept art with industrial design clarity, clean linework, controlled reflections, realistic surface materials, sharp panel separations, elegant aerodynamic shapes, and a presentation suitable for 3D modeling reference

compositional_deconstruction.background: A clean light technical presentation board with subtle grid cues, minimal interface accents, and enough negative space to separate the views clearly.

elements.desc: A large perspective hero render of the futuristic sports car placed as the main visual focus, shown in a three-quarter front view with aggressive aerodynamic lines, low ground clearance, wide tires, sculpted side intakes, LED light strips, and premium racing game proportions.
A front orthographic view of the same car, aligned cleanly as a modeling reference, with headlights, grille openings, wheel stance, and body width clearly readable.
A side orthographic view of the same car, showing full body silhouette, wheelbase, roofline, door cut, air intake design, and spoiler profile.
A rear orthographic view of the same car, showing taillight design, diffuser, exhaust treatment, rear width, and spoiler details.
A top orthographic view of the same car, showing roof shape, windshield flow, hood sculpting, and body proportions.
